purpose: Assess whether replacing remaining Claude stages with OpenAI is justified, without silently changing four-case baseline.

configuration_findings.campaign_default: gpt-5.6-sol wildcard in all presets; confirm actual run logs later
configuration_findings.standalone_knowledge: bare ModelRouter: haiku/sonnet/opus tiers, no public per-compilation model override
configuration_findings.market: bare per-job router; research/dossier explicit local model supported
configuration_findings.web_fetch: OpenAI adapter advertises web_search only; scan/rival/proof/prospect roles requiring fetch cannot be blindly switched

bounded_experiment.kind: diagnostic knowledge-profile comparison, not full-system A/B
bounded_experiment.same_inputs: ArtifactStore current_documents and build_corpus, identical knowledge_profile template/task/digest
bounded_experiment.baseline: successful resumed Claude compilation on same fingerprint; outputs already paid for
bounded_experiment.persist: save candidate output, exact material digest, source fingerprint and role-call usage separately; never overwrite brand knowledge
bounded_experiment.review: manual price/SKU bindings, conditions, unsupported scope, missing-data acknowledgment; compare latency cautiously; no automatic quality winner

decision_rule: Recommend an all-OpenAI migration only if required tools are preserved and stage quality tested. Two profile tasks alone cannot justify universal quality or full-compile savings.
preferences: No global settings changes, API-key billing or credits purchase.
